credits.title: Ivanna 2
credits.overview: Five years after surviving a massacre at a nursing home, Ambar, Dika, and Rina face Ivanna’s terror once again in a hospital. When a nurse is found beheaded, they realize Ivanna has returned and must be stopped before more victims fall.

credits.title: Muslihat
credits.overview: An orphanage moved to a new and more suitable place for the children to live. However, unexpectedly, a number of mystical disturbances occur.

credits.title: Gates of Heaven
credits.overview: Latifah's happy family life is tested when her husband passes away, leaving her to care for their child with ADHD and manage his educational foundation. Her former lover, Arman, helps with the foundation, bringing them closer until he proposes. Now, Latifah must decide whether she can accept becoming a second wife.

credits.title: Marni: The Story of Wewe Gombel
credits.overview: After moving her family to a remote village, a busy single mother loses her son, who seems to have been abducted by a vengeful spirit.

credits.title: Mukidi
credits.overview: A misunderstanding resulted in Mukidi being accepted to work as a Credit Analyst. He also approves all credit applications to help many people. Unfortunately, that decision resulted in disaster. Together with his wife, Markonah, and his two friends, Samingan and Wakijan, Mukidi must clean up the huge losses he caused.

credits.title: Innocent Vengeance
credits.overview: Adam, a talented architect has been living in a traumatic state for two years after his family was brutally murdered in front of him. Adam has been living in fear and trauma.
